scope: current textual distinction between player-visible observations, true-state debrief labels, and instructor-only detail

source_contract.observation_true_note: src/debrief/report.rs: Note: This summary distinguishes between player-observed reported metrics and true underlying states to evaluate decision quality vs outcome quality under uncertainty.
source_contract.decision_quality_boundary: src/debrief/report.rs: Decision quality and outcome quality are separate: replay preserves what each actor observed and why each modeled response occurred.

language_contract.player_visible: Observed and reported labels describe actor-visible information and committed history; they do not imply access to resolved hidden state.
language_contract.true_state: True Prior and True Outcome labels identify underlying values only in the existing post-run debrief/instructor contract; they are not live player controls.
language_contract.instructor_only: REVEALED FOR INSTRUCTOR REVIEW marks unobserved detail as privileged post-run review text rather than ordinary actor observation.
language_contract.decision_quality: Decision quality is evaluated against what the actor observed and why the modeled response occurred, separately from realized outcome quality.
language_contract.affiliation: Regional-affiliation post-run detail remains typed/CLI contract text; no separate browser true-state route is claimed.

presentation_surface.host_ownership: Host/core debrief functions own observation, true-state labeling, resolution, and any post-run instructor detail; presentation remains read-only.
presentation_surface.shared_rendering: Shared renderers may display supplied labels and debrief lines without authoring true state, outcomes, or authority.
presentation_surface.browser_boundary: The current live GUI supports competitive-regional-v1 only; this record does not establish browser-native true-state visual language.
presentation_surface.written_fallback: The distinction remains readable through text labels, history, hashes, and authority notices when audio or visual decoration is unavailable.

open_work: browser-native true-state visual language and direct visual-quality review
decision-time information recovery and causal attribution visualization
counterfactual differences and responsible distributional outcome views
instructor-surface design, export behavior, accessibility, and human educational usability review
limits: This record documents a current textual boundary only; it does not establish a complete visual language or approve an instructor product surface.
True-state labels are post-run debrief/instructor text, not a live actor observation, player control, calibrated forecast, legal conclusion, or educational result.
No true-state field, browser route, persistence, screenshot, asset, audio file, counterfactual, distributional view, export format, or authority path is created or promoted.
No human comprehension, classroom effectiveness, visual quality, accessibility, legal, policy-validity, or public-release claim is made.
